purpose: Initial reviewed engineering and research parameters for intraday replay diagnostics. Passing them is not financial validation, a profitability claim, or authority for holdout, paper, or live trading.

gates.name: controlled registry evidence
gates.rationale: Qualification evidence must match completed controlled-run registry records and stored report artifacts.

gates.name: fixed search budget accounted
gates.rationale: Every reserved candidate ordinal and status in the fixed campaign budget must remain visible.

gates.name: base result completed
gates.rationale: A missing, failed, or rejected base replay is visible evidence and cannot pass.

gates.name: minimum completed round trips
gates.rationale: Initial activity floor for a reviewed replay sample.

gates.name: minimum sessions
gates.rationale: Initial session-coverage floor.

gates.name: minimum active sessions
gates.rationale: Require activity across multiple sessions.

gates.name: minimum active session percentage
gates.rationale: Avoid interpreting a nearly inactive replay as representative.

gates.name: maximum drawdown
gates.rationale: Initial engineering drawdown bound; not a return forecast.

gates.name: maximum best trade concentration
gates.rationale: Make dependence on one positive trade visible.

gates.name: maximum best session concentration
gates.rationale: Make dependence on one positive session visible.

gates.name: maximum best N trades concentration
gates.rationale: Make dependence on a small set of positive trades visible.

gates.name: maximum symbol concentration
gates.rationale: Initial two-symbol concentration bound; not a universal diversification standard.

gates.name: no overnight positions
gates.rationale: Intraday replay must remain flat across sessions.

gates.name: no outside session trades
gates.rationale: Trades must remain inside the declared regular session.

gates.name: early close coverage
gates.rationale: Require complete coverage for any reported early-close sessions.

gates.name: configuration identity
gates.rationale: Bind all evidence to the reviewed intraday configuration.

gates.name: cost stress completed
gates.rationale: Required higher-cost replay evidence must complete.

gates.name: cost stress retention
gates.rationale: Flag a positive base whose return largely disappears under the required higher costs.

gates.name: delay stress completed
gates.rationale: Required whole-bar-delay replay evidence must complete.

gates.name: delay stress retention
gates.rationale: Flag a positive base whose return largely disappears under the required whole-bar delays.
